Rye Sourdough Baker's Percentage

Rye Sourdough is mixed from 450 g of flour at 85% water, 30% starter, 2.2% salt, and no added yeast. Rye does not form a strong elastic dough the way wheat does. Mix it, put it in a pan, and bake it through.

Percentages are of the flour you weigh out, and effective hydration also counts the flour and water inside a starter that is itself 100% hydration.
